LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Description: The Scrapbook: ready-made sheet items dragged from the Scrapbook panel onto the paper, the way SketchUp LayOut's scrapbooks work. Owned by Na__LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__.js; the panel is Na__LayoutEditor__Panel__Scrapbook__.js. A dropped item becomes ordinary sheet records - text items and vectors, grouped - so it moves, copies, prints, ungroups and undoes like anything drawn by hand.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Pieces: A piece is a list of sheet records in paper millimetres, y down, written with the sheet's own record fields (Annotation__... for text, Shape__... for vectors) but without ids or layers: a drop gives every record a fresh id and puts text on the sheet's text layer and vectors on its vector layer. Record__Kind says which a record is, 'annotation' or 'shape'. A shape may give Scrapbook__Circle { CentreMm, RadiusMm, Segments } in place of Shape__Points; the circle is written out as a closed polygon of that many points when the item is built. Records draw in the order listed, the first at the back - though, as on every sheet, all vectors draw under all text.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Items: An item is one tile in the panel and one drop: its pieces, each moved by OffsetMm. A piece of two or more records lands as a group, and an item of two or more pieces lands as a group of those groups, so one ungroup gives the pieces back. The item lands centred on the drop point, selected. Item__DrawingTypes lists the drawing types an item is offered on ('siteplan', 'architectural'); an item without the key is offered on every sheet. The panel only shows on a sheet that has at least one item.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__Tokens: A record's text can quote {Name} for a value in the Tokens block, so a number several items use is written once. {Year} is built in: the current year at the moment the item is built, so a credentials block dropped next January reads next year.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Meta.Meta__HouseSizes: Measured 14-Sep-2026 from the credentials block Adam supplied and from his A2 Location and Block Plans (BH03 D04, NP03 D09): the north point is 18 mm across, and the three lines are Open Sans at 9 pt (3.175 mm) semibold, 8 pt (2.822 mm) and 6 pt (2.117 mm). The PDF prints them in Helvetica, as it prints all sheet text.

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Tokens.Tokens__Description: Values a record's text can quote as {Name}. {Year} is built in and needs no entry here.

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Pieces.Pieces__Description: The building blocks items are made of. See Meta__Pieces.

Pieces__MappingDataCredentials.Piece__Description: The Ordnance Survey credit a site plan carries: a semibold heading, the licence number and the Crown copyright line with the current year. Left aligned on x = 0; each PosYMm is a baseline.

Pieces__NorthPoint.Piece__Description: The north point: a grey ring round a white disc, a red north half and a light grey south half to the needle, and an N at the top of the ring. 18 mm across, centred on (9, 9). It points up the paper; a site plan drawn north-up (SitePlanData__NorthAngleDeg 0) needs no turn.

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Items.Items__Description: The tiles the panel shows, in this order. See Meta__Items.

Items__List.Item__Name: Mapping Data Credentials and North Point

LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__Description: The Scrapbook panel's wording. ItemTitle is each tile's tooltip, with {name} the item's name.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__Hint: Drag an item onto the sheet. Double-click one to place it in the middle of the view.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__ReadOnly: Items can only be placed while sheets are editable.
LayoutEditor__Scrapbook__Labels.Labels__Failed: The scrapbook could not be read, so it has no items.
